**Management Summary – Project LV 988,914 €**

The tender contains critical specification gaps and pricing anomalies that jeopardize compliance and cost control. Fourteen items breach VOB/A § 7 (missing or empty short/long texts), leaving scope undefined for key positions (e.g., 1.1.10, 6.1.10, 4.1.60, 1.1.20). Eight high‑severity unit‑price deviations were identified: three grossly overstated (1.1.10 €28,800; 1.1.80 €1,200/psch; 3.2.450 €8,280) and five severely under‑priced (3.2.510, 4.1.250, 3.2.430, 5.3.180, 2.1.40) compared with median benchmarks (≈ €660). Additional medium‑level issues include unit mismatches, missing material classes, and implausibly low volumes. Immediate actions: request clarified specifications, re‑price outliers, and verify quantity units to ensure contractual validity and prevent disputes.
